block.cobblemon_safari.safari_gate.toolt: Operators only. Standing in it like a nether portal spends banked Safari time to enter the park; the warden's Pokémon roam around it. Only generated Safari Gates have a warden; one placed by hand has none.

cobblemon_safari.npc.safari_warden.name: Safari Warden
Welcome to the Safari Gate! Beyond this doorway lies the Safari Zone.
Step into the gate and wait a moment, or ask me: your banked Safari time pays for the hunt.
How do I get Safari time?
Use a Safari Ticket anywhere outside the park: its time goes to your bank.
Each visit spends what you banked. Leave early through the clerk of a rest house and I'll give the rest back.
Short of tickets? My shop trades them for apricorns, berries or an evolution stone, any kind, and explorers find some in village and ruin chests.
Take your time. My Pokémon don't mind visitors, as long as nobody throws a ball at them!
